| # clcan_fd_registerBusOffCallback {#clcan_fd_registerbusoffcallback-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

With this function a callback function can be registered for each CAN channel, which is called if a CAN bus-off occurred.

If no callback function is defined, no action is carried out.

 

Remarks:

- Registering of this callback function is optional.

- Only allowed in initialization task (e.g. fls_init_cb).

- Callback function must be defined within the CLAPI application program.
